# EduRank

> South Africa's study notes arena for grades 8–12. Students upload CAPS-aligned notes, earn PTS, unlock other students' work, and climb a national leaderboard.

EduRank is a points-only study marketplace for South African high-school students (grades 8–12). Notes are grade-locked and school-locked; moderation and teacher verification keep quality up. Real-money payout is not offered; points are an in-platform currency.
